REGISTRY EXTRACT CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office files ordinary paperwork through standardized intake forms with dated entries, maintains document control logs, and routes submissions to assigned processors.

2) What occurred: The actor prepared a shipment plan using a dated internal memo; the actor completed a manifest template in a spreadsheet with fields for date, quantity, and destination; the actor routed the document through a shared drive channel; the actor logged the submission under a misclassified category in the intake form; the actor referenced a third-party processor account in the routing field.

3) Materials/access observed: A dated internal memo; a spreadsheet manifest template; a shared drive channel; an intake form with category classification field; a processor account record.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A manifest document with fields for date, quantity, and destination; a routing field referencing a third-party account; an intake form showing misclassified category; a dated memo with plan details; a shared drive channel with document version history.
